title: Elemental Workshop III
start: Search a bookcase in Seers' Village church.

items.t: 12 pieces of coal (can be mined west of Seers' Village, at the coal trucks; these cannot be noted or in an ore box)
3 elemental ores (can be obtained during the quest)
Soft clay (you can mine clay in the mine in the north-western room and use it on the sink in the northern room to soften it, or automatically mine one by wearing a bracelet of clay)

recommended.t: Bring defence potions, super defence potions or restore potions, if you are under 66 Defence
Excalibur can be used to restore eight Defence levels

rewards.t: 2000 Smithing XP from finishing the quest
A Book of knowledge worth 6500 Smithing XP (two charges of 3250 Smithing experience each)
A total of 8500 Defence XP (via two charges of 4250 Defence XP from the Book of knowledge)
Ability to smith elemental, mind and body bodies, along with body helmets and shields.

steps.t: Search the north-east bookcase in the Seers' Village church. [Chat: Accept]
Read the ragged book.
Use soft clay on the book to get the key mould. If you do not have soft clay, you can mine some from the clay rocks in the western mine of the workshop then use it on the sink in the northern room.

Enter the Elemental Workshop and go into the mine to the west. Mine 3 elemental rocks, killing the earth elementals that appear, then pick up the 3 elemental ores that they drop. Simply killing the earth elementals wandering around the mine will not yield the ore.
In the fire elemental room (south), use the elemental ore on the furnace to create 3 elemental bars. 4 coal is required per bar.
Use 1 elemental bar on the furnace again to make a ragged elemental key.
Climb down the hatch in the centre of the middle room.
Prime the remaining two elemental bars (see primed bar on how to do this) using the jig cart, but don't infuse them with the Mind machine.
Go down the northwest stairwell.
In the middle of the hallway, open the 'Body door' on the western wall with the ragged elemental key.
Head down the stairs.

Label the levers as follows and use the interface to move them. The levers on the north and south are the same, and the levers east and west are the same so feel free to use the closest lever to your current orientation. You can use the Minigame window to hit the levers, you don't need to run to each one.
The "Reset" and "Undo" levers can be found on the west wall (when the camera is not locked into the fixed overhead view; otherwise, they're to the north)

The metallic stairs may be blocked by your interface due to the forced camera angle, so closing out of the view by pressing the magnifying glass may be required.

Enter the room and flip the lever.
Retrieve the body bar from the slot.

steps.t: Use a workbench on the first-level basement (the level with water, air, and fire elementals where you can obtain elemental ore) to create a body body. The ragged book must be in your inventory.
Quest complete!
